title: התותח של סבא

spec.palette: designed ramps, at most 5 steps each: bronze 5, wood 3, iron 3, ivory 2, glow 3, mark 1

source: hand-placed pixels at 0 deg, every column (tools/art_host/weapons/cannon_px.py); rows turned RotSprite-style (Scale2x x3, nearest), stray pixels out, a 1 px outline; the mark upright in the overlay only
character:
WHO: grandpa's bronze cannon from the founding days, pulled off its carriage: the flared bronze barrel with its bands
       and knob, two brass-rimmed gauges on stalks, a crank on a gear at the breech, one spoked carriage wheel still
       bolted to its side, a cheek of the wooden carriage under it for a handle, all held together with wire and pride.
  IDLE: it creaks, the gauge needle shivers, a bolt drops out of the wood and falls (he will pocket it). FIRE: a long
        wind-up: he cranks (the crank goes round, the gauges climb), the mouth glows, then ONE shot with a huge kick, and
        it comes apart in his hands: the wheel falls off, a gauge springs loose, bolts fly, the muzzle ring cracks.
cell_note: a bigger cell than the contract's 64: it holds the weapon at every angle with its moving parts thrown out and the toss

equip.note: 30 ticks: hauled up from the hip, it creaks; at 14 he DUSTS IT OFF: a puff of old dust rises off the barrel; ready

idle.note: 1.5 s loop: it creaks, the gauge needle shivers, a bolt drops out of the wooden cheek and falls to the floor (he pockets it: the body's)

fire.note: 156 ticks = the rule's wind-up (shot at 96). He CRANKS: the crank goes round a quarter every 12 ticks and the gauges climb (crank_1 24, crank_2 48, crank_3 72); at 84 the mouth GLOWS and the swell reddens; at 96 ONE shot: the biggest flash and kick of the arsenal, smoke; at 120 it FALLS APART in his hands: the wheel drops off, a gauge springs up on its spring, bolts fly, the wooden cheek splits, the muzzle band cracks off; he holds the wreck to the end (then the empty act tosses it)

empty.note: 12 ticks: the click (nothing left to fire, the wreck), a droop; at 6 he tosses it away in front of him

catch.note: the hand-off from the unarmed catch: it lands heavy in his hands, creaks, a puff of dust; the reveal from the last frame

aim_note: a frame's aim = degrees the weapon turns from its rest (the idle's first frame is 0), added to the body's aim; kick = [px along the barrel (negative = back), px up, degrees up]
mark: the tank's own gun carries NO star in atlas.png (the brief: never on anything an enemy holds); the mark is ONLY the overlay, drawn while our hero holds it: the small hanging tag (at most 9 x 11, the beta's pattern), an ivory luggage tag with the blue outline star 7 x 7 on a 3 px blue-and-white cord tied to a wire under the chase, 27 px ahead of the grip; upright and whole in every row, swinging with the crank, the shot and the toss
mark_rect_note: per angle row, per column: [x, y, w, h] of the mark in the cell (the 9 x 11 tag, or the 11 x 11 roundel) and mark_star = the top-left pixel of the star (7 x 7 on the tag, 9 x 9 on a roundel); atlas_mark.png holds the mark alone in the same layout

events.draw: hauled up from the hip (equip 0): a heavy creak
events.dust_off: he dusts it off (equip 14): a puff, a cough
events.ready: the act is over on this frame's last tick
events.anticipation: the wind-up begins (fire 0): he is stuck in place
events.crank_1: a crank turn (fire 24): ratchet clicks, a gauge climbs
events.crank_3: a crank turn (fire 72): the gauges near the red
events.glow: the mouth glows (fire 84): a rising whistle
events.shot: THE shot (fire 96): FX's ray of blasts from `muzzle`; full trauma, the longest hit-stop
events.fall_apart: it comes apart (fire 120): a wheel, a gauge, bolts, a band
events.reveal: RENDER fires the reveal from this pose

normal_note: by plane: every colour paints one plane of the weapon (top, front, underside ...), turned with the row; silhouette pixels face out along the edge; the upright mark faces the viewer

holds.note: THE SET'S OWN CARRY per hero body pose (the Host 12.11: a hero's face is never covered by his weapon in any pose). While the king plays one of these body animations with this weapon, draw the weapon at `aim` (degrees, the body's hand aim replaced) and its hand point moved by `offset` [x, y] px; the frame's own aim delta and kick still add. His port carry (aim 25-40) puts a long weapon across his chin and mouth; a low hip carry at -20 keeps the face and the crown clear (picture: art/weapons/host/previews/king_carry_long_weapons.png).

muzzle_note: the bore's mouth on the barrel's axis, per row and column; it glows from fire 84 (the glow event)

glow.note: the shot's colours as drawn in the mouth and the reddening swell

enemy_note: the tank fires this gun too: draw it WITHOUT atlas_mark.png when the tank holds it (no star on the enemy)

cells: the canopy flat on the floor
sprites.anchor: the cell's TOP-left at `at` (frame px; the sprite stands on the cell's bottom, centred)

catch.note: the weapon's side of the unarmed set's catch, on the same ticks and hand points as the shotgun's catch.json (the body is one builder's): frames 0-2 it comes down, 3 the catch (its grip lands on the hand), 3-4 what carried it lets go, 5-6 in the hands, 7-9 held up behind his head (layer back), the reveal from 9. Its carrier is the parachute: on the catch it folds, then lies on the floor.
